title: Room Reservations Pricing Standard: Nightly Rate by Rate Plan
content:
**Standard.** The nightly rate of a Room Reservations reservation is fixed at booking from the hotel's Flexible Rate quote for the room type and night: the plan's price is the Flexible Rate less the plan's discount off the Flexible Rate, in percent, plus the plan's package supplement per night, rounded to the cent. Group Block Rate reservations take the block's group rate instead, and Corporate Negotiated Rate reservations take the rate of the client agreement, which is never higher than the Flexible Rate less the plan's discount off the Flexible Rate. Reward Night Rate reservations carry a nightly rate of 0.00 and are paid in points under the Ashbury Rewards award chart or with Free Night Awards.

**Retired clause — no longer in force.** The former clause "the rate covers the plan's included adults; each further adult adds the plan's extra-adult charge per night, and children up to the plan's free-stay age sharing existing bedding are not counted as adults" is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis for extra-person charges. The plan figures it named remain the plan's figures.

**Content of the recorded rate.** The nightly rate recorded on the reservation includes the package supplement and the extra-adult charge and excludes tax; tax is applied at the hotel's tax rate.

**Breakfast.** When the plan includes breakfast, the plan's breakfast covers per night are served at the hotel's breakfast outlet each morning of the stay and are not billed to the folio.

**Changed nights.** When a reservation is changed, nights that are added or moved are priced at the plan's price for the new nights if the plan re-prices changed nights; otherwise the original nightly rate is kept for every night. A Group Block Rate reservation keeps the group rate only for nights inside the block dates and the shoulder nights; nights beyond them are priced at the Flexible Rate.

## Worked prices (hypothetical Flexible Rate quote of 210.00 for the room type and night)

| Rate plan | How the price is built | Nightly rate |
|---|---|---|
| Flexible Rate | 210.00 less 0%, plus 0.00 | 210.00 |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate | 210.00 less 8%, plus 0.00 | 193.20 |
| Member Flexible Rate | 210.00 less 7%, plus 0.00 | 195.30 |
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate | 210.00 less 15%, plus 0.00 | 178.50 |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate | 210.00 less 0%, plus 32.00 | 242.00 |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | the client agreement's rate, never above 210.00 less 10%, that is 189.00 | at most 189.00 |
| Reward Night Rate | paid in points or Free Night Awards | 0.00 |

The discount acts on the Flexible Rate quote and the package supplement is then added; rounding to the cent is applied to the plan's price.

## Points of judgement

- **Tax.** The recorded nightly rate never contains tax; tax is applied separately at the hotel's tax rate.
- **Group Block Rate stay running past the shoulder nights.** Nights inside the block dates and shoulder nights keep the group rate; nights beyond them are priced at the Flexible Rate.
- **Date change on a plan that does not re-price changed nights.** The original nightly rate is kept for every night.

superseded_clauses: The rate covers included_adults adults; each further adult adds extra_adult_charge_per_night_usd per night, and children up to children_stay_free_max_age years sharing existing bedding are not counted as adults.
